Name: Daggerfist
Information:
**Daggerfist**

Daggerfists are martial artists who train under the Way of the Slicing Nail, attempting to turn their bodies into lethal weapons. They learn from teachings passed down through the Blackwind Temple, and in return act as its guards, attendants, and footsoldiers.

Information Sections.Title: Daggerfist
Information Sections.Text: Daggerfists are martial artists who train under the Way of the Slicing Nail, attempting to turn their bodies into lethal weapons. They learn from teachings passed down through the Blackwind Temple, and in return act as its guards, attendants, and footsoldiers.

traits.name: Killing Blow
traits.description: When the daggerfist scores a critical hit, their target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they take an additional 14 (3d8) slashing damage from the attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The daggerfist makes two weapon attacks.

actions.name: Foxpaw Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Swift Action
bonus_actions.description: The daggerfist takes the Dash or Disengage action.

reactions.name: Deflect Missiles
reactions.description: When hit by a ranged weapon attack, the daggerfist may reduce the damage they take from it by 1d10 + 10. If this reduces its damage to 0, the daggerfist may target another creature within 30 feet of them to make a Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit against, and on a successful hit, the target is hit by the projectile instead, dealing the damage it would have originally dealt before the reduction.
